# Acceptance d462b R5 (N3). The agent step of a round item is lost twice. The first lost agent leaves the worktree clean,
# the second commits a file. The base branch moves on the remote after each loss. The note of the third start lists the
# commit of the agent and no commit of the base.
isolate

exec git init -q -b main origin
exec git -C origin add readme.txt
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m start
exec git -C origin checkout -q -b integration/r1
exec git -C origin add BASE_MARKER
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m base
exec git -C origin checkout -q main

fixture project.star config/projects/local.star
replace config/projects/local.star '~/work/your-repo' $WORK/origin
# The script tests the round, not the sandbox, so its project keeps the sandbox off, though the fixture project file sets it on.
replace config/projects/local.star 'sandbox = "on"' 'sandbox = "off"'
subst flow/round.star
subst fake/claude
chmod 755 fake/claude

exec beehavereal item add local round/integration/r1 --title 'The round' --body-file body.txt
! exec beehavereal run round/integration/r1 local --workflow flow/round.star &
waitfile started.1
kill -KILL
wait

exec git -C origin checkout -q integration/r1
exec git -C origin add MOVED_MARKER
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m moved
exec git -C origin checkout -q main

! exec beehavereal run round/integration/r1 local --workflow flow/round.star &
waitfile started.2
kill -KILL
wait

exec git -C origin checkout -q integration/r1
exec git -C origin add SECOND_MARKER
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m second
exec git -C origin checkout -q main

exec beehavereal run round/integration/r1 local --workflow flow/round.star
stdout 'item round/integration/r1 finished'

# CELL R5a: the note of the third start names the commit of the agent.
exists prompt.3
grep 'agent.txt' prompt.3
# CELL R5b: the note names no commit of the base.
! grep 'MOVED_MARKER' prompt.3
! grep 'SECOND_MARKER' prompt.3

-- body.txt --
The round of the base.
-- origin/readme.txt --
The source repository.
-- origin/BASE_MARKER --
base marker
-- origin/MOVED_MARKER --
moved
-- origin/SECOND_MARKER --
second
-- flow/round.star --
def main(item):
    agent(name = "probe", prompt = "prompts/probe.md", model = "m")
-- flow/prompts/probe.md --
Probe the folder.
-- fake/claude --
#!/bin/sh
if [ "${1:-}" = "--version" ]; then echo 1.0.0; exit 0; fi
n=$(cat "@WORK@/starts" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
n=$((n + 1))
echo "$n" > "@WORK@/starts"
cat > "@WORK@/prompt.$n"
git rev-parse HEAD > "@WORK@/agent.head.$n"
if [ "$n" -eq 1 ]; then echo x > "@WORK@/started.1"; sleep 30; fi
if [ "$n" -eq 2 ]; then echo agent > agent.txt; git add agent.txt; git -c user.name=a -c user.email=a@example.com commit -q -m agent; echo x > "@WORK@/started.2"; sleep 30; fi
echo '{"type":"result","session_id":"s1","result":"done"}'
